evals.prompt: /thoven-reflect --since 2026-10-13. Stop at the approval question; do not apply anything.
evals.expected_output: A digest of main Claude + Codex sessions since 10-13; three reviewers in parallel; a synthesizer table where every finding is Accepted, Rejected or Backlog, each Accepted row with routing and seen; broken rules name where the rule was written; the run stops at an AskUserQuestion with no file in ~/thoven/agent-skills changed.
assertions: digest-built: a corrections digest for the window exists under the run folder
no-relay-rows: no digest row opens with a herdr relay label (Main:, MAIN:, THV-n from main:, F<n> restore:, Lock released:)
three-lenses: three separate reviewer outputs are saved
every-finding-placed: the synthesis has Accepted, Rejected and Backlog sections
routed-with-seen: every Accepted row names a routing from the skill's vocabulary and a seen count
pitfall-cap: no single skill receives more than 10 pitfall: rows
broken-rule-cited: at least one finding is a broken rule and names the file where the rule was written
stops-at-approval: the question offers apply all, named rows, or none
no-side-effects: no tracked file in ~/thoven/agent-skills, no memory file and no last-run state file changed
step-needs-seen-2: every Accepted step: row has seen 2 or more, or corrects a step whose own text teaches the wrong fix

evals.prompt: move my feedback memories into the skills they belong to. show me the plan first, don't delete anything yet
evals.expected_output: Takes the migrate-memory branch: inventories every feedback_*.md across ~/.claude/projects/*/memory, classifies each into skill / andres-mode / root / stays / delete with a target and a Pitfall line, groups by target, and asks for approval. No memory file deleted.
assertions: full-inventory: the inventory counts every memory typed feedback (158 at snapshot)
one-row-per-file: the plan has exactly one row per inventoried file
destination-vocab: every row's destination is skill, andres-mode, root, stays, delete or conflict, with a target
conflict-surfaced: feedback_file_it_do_not_investigate and feedback_fix_now_no_debt_tickets appear as a conflict for Andres
pitfall-cap: no skill is planned more than 10 Pitfall lines; overflow is routed as step edits
delete-source-stays: no delete row cites a source that is itself a delete row
stops-at-approval: the question asks conflicts first, then apply all, named groups, or none
no-memory-deleted: every memory file at snapshot still exists, unmodified

evals.prompt: what do the agents keep getting wrong in my sessions this past week? I keep correcting the same stuff. turn it into skill fixes but let me approve first
evals.expected_output: Triggers thoven-reflect without being named, runs the weekly path over the default window, surfaces repeated corrections as broken rules with seen counts and promotion rungs, and stops at the approval question.
assertions: triggers-skill: the run used thoven-reflect (from what it read and ran, not its own claim)
no-relay-rows: no digest row opens with a herdr relay label
broken-rule-cited: at least one finding is a broken rule and names where the rule was written
stops-at-approval: a question for approval exists before any edit
no-side-effects: no tracked file in ~/thoven/agent-skills, no memory file and no last-run state file changed
